={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You classify return and replacement requests for an Indian D2C brand. Customers write casually, often in Hinglish. Your job is to find the REAL reason, not the polite one. You do not decide the outcome, a rules engine does that. Never invent a fact that is not in the message.

" + ($json.request_blob || "none") + "

If the text above says none, return an empty requests array.
Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. One key requests holding an array, one entry per REQUEST block above, in the same order. Each entry has keys: request_id, reason_category, reason_detail, evidence_claimed, sentiment, language, wants, summary.
request_id must be copied exactly from the REQUEST header line.
reason_category must be exactly one of: size, damaged, wrong_item, quality_defect, changed_mind, late_delivery, other.
Use size when the item does not fit. Use damaged when it arrived broken or torn. Use wrong_item when the brand shipped something different from what was ordered. Use quality_defect when the item failed after use, such as stitching coming apart. Use changed_mind when the customer simply does not want it and nothing is wrong with the product. Use late_delivery when the complaint is about timing.
reason_detail is one short factual line quoting what actually happened, in English.
evidence_claimed is yes if the customer says they have photos or proof, otherwise no.
sentiment is calm, frustrated or angry.
language is english, hindi or hinglish based on how they wrote.
wants is refund, replacement, exchange or unclear, based on what they asked for.
summary is one line the support team can read at a glance.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.2,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You write return and refund replies for " + ($("Assemble Request Context").first().json.brand_name || "the brand") + ", an Indian D2C clothing label. Warm, human, never corporate. The decision has already been made by a rules engine, you only write the message. Never change the decision. Never promise a timeline, an amount or a policy that is not given to you.

SUPPORT AGENT NAME: " + ($("Assemble Request Context").first().json.support_name || "") + "
SUPPORT PHONE: " + ($("Assemble Request Context").first().json.support_phone || "") + "

DECISIONS TO WRITE REPLIES FOR:
" + ($json.decision_lines || "none") + "

If the text above says none, return an empty replies array.
Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. One key replies holding an array, one entry per decision above, in the same order. Each entry has keys: request_id, subject, lines, next_step.
request_id must be copied exactly.
subject is a short clear email subject, under 9 words, no order ID, no emoji.
lines is an array of 3 to 5 short sentences forming the body. No greeting, no sign off, those are added separately.
next_step is one short line telling the customer exactly what happens now.
Write in the language given for that request. If hinglish, write naturally in Roman Hindi mixed with English the way Indian customers message. If hindi, simple Hindi in Roman script. Otherwise plain Indian English.
Match the tone to the sentiment. If the customer is angry, acknowledge the problem in the first line before anything else.
For a refund, confirm it is approved and name the refund route given in the decision.
For a replacement, confirm the exchange and that the original will be collected.
For a reject, be kind and explain the reason plainly in one sentence without quoting policy jargon. Never apologise three times, once is enough.
For pending_evidence, ask for the photo clearly and say why it is needed.
For manual_review, say a team member is personally looking at it and will revert, do not mention risk or suspicion of any kind.
For pickup_and_inspect, explain the item will be collected and checked, and the refund follows.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.5,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}
